title: OpenMRS DDI Knowledge Base (normalized)
description: The drug interaction knowledge base. Normalized tables joined by id: mechanisms (stored once), drugs, drug-drug interaction rows that reference both, and DDInter's drug-disease rows (disease_interactions) with their descriptions interned once in disease_notes.

mechanisms.description: Keyed by group id. The sentinel group '-1' has null text and represents pairs DDInter lists without a mechanism description.

id.description: DDInter internal id; stable key referenced by interactions.

rxcui.description: RxNorm ingredient RxCUI; null with a documented gap for a small set of obsolete/unmapped concepts.

atc.description: RxNorm level-5 ATC substance codes (7 characters, e.g. C09AA03).

brand_names.description: RxNorm brand-name (BN) concepts related to the ingredient, including brands of combination products that contain it (Vytorin lists under simvastatin and ezetimibe). US-centric: Panadol is present, Calpol is not. Intended as aliases for matching clinician text.

interactions.description: Interaction rows: [drug_a_id, drug_b_id, severity, group_id]. Join *_id -> drugs[].id and group_id -> mechanisms{}.

disease_notes.description: Keyed by note id. The description and references behind one or more drug-disease rows; DDInter reuses a class-level paragraph across the drugs in a class, so it is stored once.

text.description: Free-text description from DDInter 2.0's drug-disease table.

references.description: Literature and product-label citations as DDInter lists them.

disease_interactions.description: Drug-disease rows: [drug_id, condition, severity, note_id]. Join drug_id -> drugs[].id and note_id -> disease_notes{}. The condition is DDInter's (MeSH-style) name, e.g. 'Acidosis, Lactic'. A consumer may derive a condition-mediated finding for two drugs from these rows; that is an inference, not a DDInter pairwise rating, and should be labelled as such.

derived_interactions.description: AN INFERENCE TIER, NOT DDINTER RATINGS. One row per directional chain: a sentence in the cause drug's drug-disease text says it causes or worsens a condition (whole-word match, causal cue, no precaution phrasing), and the rated drug carries a drug-disease row for that condition. Rows: [cause_drug_id, cause_condition, cause_severity, cause_note_id, rated_drug_id, condition, rated_severity, rated_note_id]. Join drug ids -> drugs[].id and note ids -> disease_notes{}. Consumers must present these as derived, below DDInter's pairwise ratings, and never assign the pair a severity of their own.

prefixItems.description: the cause drug's own condition row whose text names the condition
the rated drug's severity for the condition
